name: qwen38-skill-creator
description: Compile rich source knowledge into a compact Qwen 3.8 27B runtime skill. Use when creating a new Qwen skill, converting a skill written for OpenAI/DeepSeek/Claude/Gemma into a Qwen 3.8 skill, or revising an existing Qwen skill after failed executions. Do NOT use for general Qwen prompting guides, one-shot prompts with no skill deliverable, or skills targeting a runtime other than Qwen 3.8 27B.
